trace.question: User No.23853 gave a comment to a post at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12, was that post well-finished?
trace.evidence: user no. 23853 refers to UserId = '23853'; at 9:08:18 on 2013/7/12 refers to CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'; not well-finished refers to ClosedDate IS NULL and vice versa

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS WellFinished
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.UserId = 23853
  AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0'

trace.final_sql:
